title: Autocomplete regresssion in 4.4 in gdscript editor (?)
body:
### Tested versions

For what i tested, v4.3.stable.official [77dcf97d8], this bug does not exist. In 4.4rc2 and above, it does. Ill try looking for when this regression happened but i couldn't find any obvious pull requests merged, So ill have to look. It might also not be a "regression" but since i couldn't find any specific pull request documenting this behavior I assume it is not an intended feature.

### System information

Godot v4.4.rc2 - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6636) - AMD Ryzen 5 2600X Six-Core Processor (12 threads)

### Issue description

In Godot 4.3, When accepting autocomplete before an attached word, the accepted autocomplete adds itself before the attached word. I feel this is expected behavior.
In Godot 4.4, doing the same thing **deletes** the word after it. This makes it so every time you autocomplete you have to be aware of this behavior and before writing whatever you wanted to write, have to pre-emptively add a space/dot character so it doesn't delete the next word. From my experience so far it seems really unintuitive, even in the case it was added purposefully.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open any GDScript.
2. Go to/write any line.
3. Write and accept an autocomplete, connected to the word after it without a space/dot. Once accepted, the word after it should be deleted.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

This should happen in any version of Godot after 4.4rc2.
